messages.english: Review conflicting shape versions on your map.
messages.translation: Hlahloba mefuta e hananang ya dibopeho mmapeng wa hao.
Hlahloba mefuta ya dibopeho tsa mmapa
Mmapa → Dibopeho tse hlokang qeto ya hao

messages.english: Open the list of shapes needing a decision. Review each preserved version before choosing which to keep, or keep both when offered. Download a backup when the map offers one; older app versions still need care.
messages.translation: Bula lethathamo la dibopeho tse hlokang qeto. Hlahloba mofuta ka mong o bolokilweng pele o kgetha oo o lokelang ho o boloka, kapa o boloke ka bobedi ha o fuwa monyetla. Jarolla khopi ya tshireletso ha mmapa o fana ka yona; mefuta ya kgale ya sesebediswa e ntse e hloka tlhokomelo.
